en-US.author: Ivan Charapanau
en-US.description: Effortlessly run LLM backends, APIs, frontends, and services with one command.
en-US.longDescription: Harbor is a containerized LLM toolkit that allows you to run LLMs and additional services. It consists of a CLI and a companion App that allows you to manage and run AI services with ease.
en-US.name: Harbor
en-US.releaseNotes:
Security
- Open WebUI no longer ships with a public session-signing secret. New installs get a random per-install key, and harbor doctor and harbor up webui warn when an existing install still uses the old h@rb0r default (#307, reported by @gdevenyi).
  Existing installs keep their current value, because rotating it logs every user out and resets MFA enrolment. To rotate:
  harbor webui secret "$(openssl rand -base64 48)" >/dev/null 2>&1
  harbor restart webui
Fixes
- harbor doctor no longer exits silently on podman systems, so install.sh and the Harbor App setup check pass there too (#304, reported by @gdevenyi).
- MetaMCP now builds on podman (#306, reported by @gdevenyi).
- mcpo starts again with current FastAPI releases (#305, reported by @gdevenyi).
New
- Boost: set HARBOR_UBERLLM_API_KEY to add UberLLM's models as a Boost backend (#308 by @PSA-Team-source).
Full Changelog: https://github.com/av/harbor/compare/v0.5.19...v0.5.20
